messages.author: sarthak_2005
messages.content:
Hello,

I am raising this ticket regarding my ViBe completion and HP correction issue.

Before the deadline, several videos that were earlier marked as “Completed” were automatically reset and no longer reflected as completed. Due to this tracking issue, my progress remained below 100% even though I had completed the required content from my side.

I reported this issue before the deadline and I received confirmation from support that:
1. I would be considered as having completed the ViBe course.
2. Any HP reduction in this regard would be reverted.

However, as of now:
• Completion status still does not reflect correctly.
• The -10% HP penalty has not been reverted.
• The +10% HP completion reward has not been applied.

The deadline passed a week ago, and this issue was reported in advance. Since it directly affects my HP and completion status despite prior confirmation, I kindly request you to verify my activity logs and process the correction at the earliest.

Please let me know if any additional information is required from my side.
